objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact containing company-wide or locally-defined regulations, instructions, or procedural information that undergoes a complete lifecycle including creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document within the document pyramid (1-4)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or designation of the document

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix assigned to document type (e.g., RL, P)

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit identifier per document type

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow or lifecycle state of the document

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes effective

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person responsible for creating the document

attributes.name: coauthor
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who checks technical and formal aspects of the document

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing the document

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person who translates document content into other languages

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assigned to view the document

attributes.name: sourceformat
attributes.description: Original file format of document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or objects referenced by this document

attributes.name: itapplication
attributes.description: IT systems or applications relevant to the document

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Company or organizational unit for which the document applies

attributes.name: areaofvalidity
attributes.description: Geographic, functional, or organizational scope where document applies

attributes.name: archiveduration
attributes.description: Period for which archived document is retained before physical deletion

attributes.name: extendedvalidityperiod
attributes.description: Period of time between document release and when validity extension check is required

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level such as code of conduct or organizational structure.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally-defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: proceduralinstruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons to achieve objectives within a framework.

objs.name: workinstruction
objs.description: A document type containing detailed work steps and special procedures for sub-processes, often supplemented with forms and checklists.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in roles such as reader, author, reviewer, or releaser.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: usergroup
attributes.description: Group membership that defines authorization scope

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A collection of users with common authorization rights and responsibilities.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role associated with the group

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document, subject to its own versioning and triggering new versions of the main document when modified or archived.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow status of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: A non-controlled document attachment not subject to the main document's release cycle, which can be released and deleted independently.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name of the additional information

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as brief instructions, photos, or screenshots

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document that can be created by employees with author rights without affecting the current version or content.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Description of the proposed change

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the change proposal such as proposed or scheduled

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: An automatically created request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

attributes.name: triggereddate
attributes.description: Date when the request was automatically created

attributes.name: documentreference
attributes.description: Reference to the document being checked

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has additional validity.

attributes.name: createddate
attributes.description: Date when the override request was created

attributes.name: archivestartdate
attributes.description: Date from which the archive duration begins

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created only by Business Admin group.

attributes.name: createddate
attributes.description: Date when the reactivation request was created

attributes.name: requesteddocument
attributes.description: Reference to the document being reactivated

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive notifications about document releases and participate in acknowledgement workflows.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution type such as email notification or acknowledgement requirement

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature documenting the approval action of a workflow participant on a specific document version.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: Name of the person providing the signature

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role of participant such as author, reviewer, or releaser

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when signature was applied

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version to which the signature applies

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view displaying documents and information relevant to a user based on their authorization and distribution list membership.

attributes.name: userrole
attributes.description: System role for which the dashboard is configured

attributes.name: filtercriteria
attributes.description: Parameters used to determine which documents appear in the dashboard

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation or search function providing filtered lists of documents based on selected parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of report such as status report or search

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: User role for which the report is available

attributes.name: selectionparameters
attributes.description: Criteria available for filtering report results

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a recipient that they have received and reviewed a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State indicating whether acknowledgement has been confirmed

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: User who provided or is requested to provide acknowledgement

attributes.name: confirmationdate
attributes.description: Date when acknowledgement was confirmed

objs.name: organizationalunit
objs.description: A logical grouping of the organization to which documents can be assigned for validity or distribution purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational unit

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business or operational risk that can be linked to documents for reference and governance purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Description of the risk

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate instance or tenant in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be controlled.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the client

objs.name: documenttemplate
objs.description: A predefined structure or format that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type.

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Type of document for which the template applies

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format such as MS Word, Excel, or PowerPoint
